Args_DeadMsg_msg: A message to send in ghost chat
Args_GivePerm_commands: Commands to grant. Use "all" to give all permissions. You can specify multiply commands like that: "giveperm 1 .adminpm .adminchat .smite"
Args_Help_command: Input name of command to get more info about it, or type 'all' to get command list
Args_ItemEdit_action: Action to do with this component. Leave empty to get list of actions
Args_ItemEdit_component: Name of component or position in list. Leave empty to get list of components
Args_Jobban_duration: Duration of job-ban. Leave empty to permanent ban (ex. "6d 23h 59m 59s")
Args_Jobban_job: Job that will be banned for this player
Args_Jobban_reason: Reason, why player has been job-banned.
Args_Lang_language: Language to change. Use ".lang all" to get list of languages
Args_NearChars_size: Searching range, shaped as circle. Default: 100
Args_NearItems_ignorewires: If true, command will ignore wires on walls. If false, it will not. Default: true
Args_NearItems_size: Searching range, shaped as circle. Default: 100
Args_PermList_player: Name/ID/SteamID of player. Leave empty to check yourself.
Args_RevokePerm_commands: Commands to revoke. You can specify multiply commands like that: "giveperm 1 .adminpm .adminchat .smite"
Args_SeeGhostChat_status: Can be 'true' (only enable), 'false' (only disable) or 'switch' (switch between on/off)
Args_SeeGhostChat_target: Player to toggle this abillity. Leave empty to apply it yourself
Args_Smite_smite: Smite to do. Type ".smite help" to get list of smites
Args_SpawnChar_args: Arguments for spawn. You can specify multiple arguments. I.e: "-skincolor 2 -headtype 14 -haircolor 16"
Args_SpawnChar_id: ID of species to spawn. Write "-h" or "-help" instead to see list of arguments
Args_SubmarineGodmode_value: Enable, disable or switch the godmode to submarine. Can be 'true', 'false' or 'switch'. If unspecified, godmode will be switched.
Args_SubmarineLock_axis: Axis to toggle lock onto. Can be 'x', 'y', 'xy'. Default: 'xy'
Args_SubmarineThrow_mode: 'set': (Default) replaces current motion vector with new, 'add': Adds new motion vector to the current one.
Args_SubmarineThrow_vector: Motion vector. Can be 'cursor', 'ncursor' или вектор в формате X;Y. 'cursor': Set vector by cursor direction. The further the cursor, the faster the speed. 'ncursor': Set vector by cursor direction but with fixed speed.
Args_SubmarineTp_position: Position to teleport on. If unspecified, submarine will teleport on cursor. Can be 'cursor', 'start', 'end' or X;Y.
Args_ToggleAHelp_status: Can be 'true' (only enable), 'false' (only disable) or 'switch' (switch between on/off)
Args_ToggleBwoink_status: Can be 'true' (only enable), 'false' (only disable) or 'switch' (switch between on/off)
Args_UnJobban_job: Job that will be unbanned for this player or ID of job ban to be pardoned. Leave empty to revoke all job bans
